mainEntity.name: What is the cost of a site feasibility consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a site feasibility consultation varies based on factors such as the property's location, size, and complexity, as well as the extent of research required. We provide a clear estimate upfront after understanding your specific needs. While there is a fee, this investment can save you significant time and money by identifying potential issues before they become expensive problems during construction.
